summary: Players draw and place hexagonal tiles to build out a shared landscape, competing for area-majority control around castles as clan leaders rebuilding a ruined Scotland. It plays as a fairly light, accessible tile-layer with contracts and end-game bonuses layered on top of Reiner Knizia's typically streamlined core rules.

interaction.kind: area majority on a shared hex grid
interaction.detail: Tiles are placed onto one shared board, so where you build directly affects which castles and regions opponents can still contest, making it a game of jostling for position rather than independent tableau-building. Contracts and bonuses give each player some private goals layered on top of that shared map.

scoring.how_you_win: You win by accumulating the most points from controlling contested areas of the board and completing your contracts, tallied once tiles run out or the end trigger fires.
